slides.title: Claude
slides.narration: A ninety-second guide to Claude, from the AiGovOps Foundation and the NCW AI Camp.

slides.title: What it is
lines: Anthropic's AI assistant — nuanced writing, careful reasoning, long documents
Free tier right in your browser; Pro and Max for heavier use
Patient, and it shows its thinking
slides.narration: Claude is Anthropic's A-I assistant. It's the one to reach for when you're writing something that has to land right, reasoning through a hard problem, or working with a long document. There's a free tier right in your browser, and paid Pro and Max plans when you need more.

slides.title: What's cool for NCW
lines: Teachers: get a delicate parent email's tone exactly right; summarize a dense article
Small business: turn a messy brain-dump into a real plan; draft a policy in plain language
Community leaders: shape a proposal until it reads clearly
slides.narration: Here's what's cool for our valley. Teachers: workshop a delicate parent email until the tone is exactly right, or summarize a dense research article in minutes. Small businesses: turn a messy brain-dump into a real plan, or draft a policy in plain language. It explains its reasoning as it goes.

slides.title: The rules — the AiGovOps way
lines: A human on the trigger — you read it before it goes out
Keep the receipts — save your prompt and the answer
Mind the data cost of “free” — no student records, IEPs, or private details in a free tool
slides.narration: Now the rules, the AiGovOps way. Keep a human on the trigger: you read it before it goes out. Keep the receipts: save your prompt and the answer. And mind the data cost of free — never paste student records, an I-E-P, or a customer's private details into a free tool, because free tools learn from what you type.
